name: controls-first-dialog
title: Controls-first device dialog
description: Compose everyday device controls and secondary configuration with BaseCardDialog and its More actions navigation.
when: A device needs everyday controls and secondary settings in one focused dialog.
context: Caller supplies translated labels, content and a launch-button returnFocusRef
Feature owns capability checks, provider-neutral commands, saving and errors
review: Controls appear first
More actions and Back to controls work
Closing and reopening returns to controls
Keyboard dismissal, focus containment and return
Long titles, phone/tablet/desktop and all four themes

name: detail-sheet
title: Detail sheet with shared header
description: Compose a mobile detail sheet with a direct-child SheetSurfaceHeader, localized dismissal and separately padded body.
when: Focused detail or commands need a mobile sheet; enable responsive only when desktop should use the same surface.
context: Caller supplies translated title, close label, body and a launch-button returnFocusRef
Mobile-only by default; responsive enables desktop
review: Header remains a direct child of SheetSurface
Close label reaches the shell and header
Dismissal and focus return
Long body scroll and mobile keyboard
Mobile-only and responsive desktop behavior in all four themes

name: settings-field
title: Settings field with validation
description: Compose FieldBlock and Input with unique label and message associations, visible validation and native required/disabled state.
when: An existing settings workflow needs a labeled text field with validation.
context: Caller supplies translated copy, value and change callback
Feature owns validation, save, cancellation and persistence
review: Label activates its own input
Hint or error is associated with the input
Multiple instances have unique IDs
Required, disabled and error states
Long translated copy and all four themes

name: empty-card
title: Empty card with optional action
description: Compose BaseCard and CardEmptyState with a single optional configuration action and caller-owned dimensions.
when: A configured card has no selection or matching content; device unavailable state uses its device family instead.
context: Caller owns card dimensions and translated copy
An action requires a supported destination and callback
Small, medium and large compositions require separate review
review: Small, medium and large cards
With and without a supported action
Long names and translated copy
No matches versus unconfigured content
All four themes and keyboard action

name: compact-device-card
title: Compact device-card composition
description: Compose a small BaseCard with identity, normalized state and one capability-gated action using Navet's shared controls.
when: A simple device can be understood through one state label and one household action; richer devices use their existing family recipe.
context: Caller owns card dimensions and translated labels
Caller supplies normalized state and only supported actions
Feature routes commands to the entity's owning provider
review: Identity, state, exception, then primary action
Active, inactive, unavailable and unsupported action
One primary control path
Long names, translated copy and touch target
All four themes and keyboard action
